in_sanskrit.name: Akālmaṣa
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Akāl means 'Beyond Time', and Maṣa means 'Moon'. So, Akālmaṣa means 'One who is beyond time' or 'Timeless'.

in_hindi.name: Akalmash
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Immortal, Timeless
in_hindi.long_meaning: Akalmash एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from Sanskrit, Akalmash means 'Immortal' or 'Timeless'. In Hindu mythology, Akalmash is a name of Lord Shiva, signifying his eternal existence and power.
